visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman wearing a long beige skirt and a white t-shirt runs and dances energetically in front of a white building. Stacked cardboard boxes are seen on the sidewalk. Large white text overlays the center of the frame. (2) The scene cuts to a shot of three people with backpacks entering a store with a white sign that reads 'OKINAWA SHIN BOO'. The glass door has several colorful stickers and advertisements. (3) A woman with short dark hair in a black t-shirt is interviewed outside. She gestures with her hands while smiling. Cars and a building are visible in the background. (4) Inside the store, a woman in a black 'SPAM' branded t-shirt holds up various snack packages. She shows a bag of green bitter melon chips, then a jar of spices, followed by large red boxes and bags of shrimp crackers. (5) In a corner of the shop, two young children—a girl in a pink floral dress and a boy in a grey t-shirt—play with kitchen-themed toys near a wooden bookshelf. (6) The camera pans to show several customers holding plastic shopping baskets filled to the brim with colorful snack packages. The woman in the 'SPAM' shirt continues to interact with the crowd.
